name: Short-Only Donchian Breakout – USDJPY
description: Short-only Turtle-style Donchian channel breakout strategy on USD/JPY daily bars. Short entry when close breaks below the prior bar's 55-day Donchian lower band (lowest low) with ADX(14) > 20 trend filter. Exit short when close touches/crosses above the prior bar's 20-day upper band. Position sizing: fixed 2% equity allocation per trade, no stop loss.
source:
# Short-Only Donchian Channel Breakout Strategy – USDJPY
# Entry: Close breaks below prior bar's 55-day Donchian lower band + ADX(14) > 20
# Exit:  Close touches/crosses above prior bar's 20-day Donchian upper band
# Sizing: Fixed 2% equity allocation per trade, no stop loss

# --- Data Source ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l

# --- Donchian Channels ---
# 55-period channel for entry signals
dc55 = donchian_channel(window=55)(h=high, l=low)
dc55_lower = dc55.donchian_lower

# 20-period channel for exit signals
dc20_exit = donchian_channel(window=20)(h=high, l=low)
dc20_exit_upper = dc20_exit.donchian_upper

# --- Lag bands by 1 bar to avoid look-ahead bias ---
# Today's close is compared against YESTERDAY's channel levels
dc55_lower_prev = dc55_lower >> 1
dc20_exit_upper_prev = dc20_exit_upper >> 1

# --- ADX Trend Filter ---
adx_val = adx(period=14)(h=high, l=low)
trending = adx_val > 20

# --- Short Entry Signal ---
# Short entry: close breaks below prior bar's 55-day lower band
short_breakout = close < dc55_lower_prev

# --- Short Exit Signal ---
# Exit short: close touches/crosses above prior bar's 20-day upper band
exit_short = close >= dc20_exit_upper_prev

# --- Combine entry + exit using hold_until ---
# Hold short state from breakout (with ADX filter) until 20-day exit fires
short_state = hold_until()(enter=short_breakout and trending, exit=exit_short)

# --- Event marker for short breakout signals ---
event_marker(schema=EventMarkerSchema(
    title="Short Breakout",
    icon=Icon.TrendingDownIcon,
    schemas=[
        ColumnSpec(title="Close", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
        ColumnSpec(title="ADX(14)", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, card_slot=CardSlot.Details),
        ColumnSpec(title="Filter", table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
    ]
))(close, adx_val, short_breakout)

# --- Execution ---
long_and_short_zone()(short_entry=short_state)

# Fixed 2% equity allocation per trade, no stop loss
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=2)
